results.title: Sunset Strip Killers
results.overview: Based on a true story, in 1980s Los Angeles, nurse Carol Bundy falls for the charming but deadly Doug Clark. Drawn into his world of murder, obsession, and blood, she becomes complicit in shocking crimes across the city.

results.title: Special Op: Rent-a-Cop
results.overview: After falling in love and leaving Special Ops, special agent Brock Belfry finds himself working security in a small town and ends up escorting a van full of senior citizens to Las Vegas for their summer trip. But the trip will not go smoothly as he realizes that his archenemies have tracked him down and plot to take him out.

results.title: NXT The Great American Bash 2026
results.overview: The 2026 NXT The Great American Bash, also promoted as NXT The Great American Bash: Orlando, is a professional wrestling livestreaming event produced by WWE. It is the 14th Great American Bash under the WWE banner, the seventh annual produced specifically for its developmental brand NXT, and the 28th Great American Bash event overall.

results.title: 125, rue des Malaises
results.overview: Before leaving, Laurent Perrier wants to settle his affairs and ensure nothing is left unresolved.

results.title: Encountering the Unknown: Inside DISCLOSURE DAY
results.original_title: Encountering the Unknown: Inside DISCLOSURE DAY
results.overview: Steven Spielberg, Emily Blunt, and the rest of the cast uncover the film-making secrets and real-life inspirations behind the movie.

results.title: Countryside
results.overview: Estranged brothers, Sean and Luke, return to their rural childhood home. When a zombie outbreak throws the world into chaos, they have no choice but to confront the sacrifices they are willing to make for family.

results.title: Mare Sapiens
results.overview: Below the surface, the alien is us. Filmed entirely underwater with natural light and ambient sound, MARE SAPIENS moves through the Bay of Marseille as a space where living forms, infrastructures, and machines coexist. The film assembles a sensory field without commentary or hierarchy, letting the sea appear not as background or resource, but as a milieu that absorbs, resists, and persists.

results.title: Inside the Trustor Scandal
results.overview: For the first time since 1997, Joachim Posener finally emerges from hiding and allows himself to be interviewed about his life and the Trustor affair. Twenty-seven years ago, he disappeared without a trace, and ever since, he has been on the international most wanted list. Now, Karin af Klintberg searches for him to find out how he lives and where he's been hiding all these years. But perhaps above all, to uncover what everyone is wondering: Was he guilty? Through new and opposing testimonies from never-before-heard voices, Karin simultaneously continues the search for the truth about the coup. How could five people swindle 600 million kr and still go free? And where did the money actually go?

results.title: For the Opponents
results.overview: In the tough neighborhood of Tepito, a boy faces the great Mexican dream: becoming a boxing champion.

results.title: Don't Politicize
results.overview: In the northern region of Hungary, the populist propaganda of Orbán’s regime dictates the lives of military high school student Luca and her friends. But how do you distinguish between the opinions imposed on you and your own intrinsic beliefs in the most forming period of your life?  DON'T POLITICIZE is part 1 of the diptych DON'T POLITICIZE : GO HUNGARY

results.title: Мэхээлэчээн Булчут
results.overview: The wise hunter Mekhelecheen, living in harmony with nature, is concerned about his grandson Mishuk. The boy, spoiled by life, doesn't appreciate the legacy of his ancestors and doesn't understand the beauty of the harsh taiga. To pass on ancient knowledge to his grandson, his grandfather takes him into the dense forest. However, the journey turns into unexpected trials: Mishuk and his faithful dog, Sergekh, become lost in the forest. In despair, they encounter a magical deer—the guardian of the taiga—who grants the boy the amazing ability to understand the language of all living things. Together with his grandfather, he fights poachers to save the Spirit of the Taiga.

results.title: La chaleur
results.overview: It’s unusually hot on the beaches of the Landes, and 17-year-old Marouane is spending his last day at the campground with a nagging fear: will the body he buried on the beach the day before be discovered? Marouane also wonders if he might be falling in love with the charming Giulia.

results.title: Ei Shohorer Gaan
results.overview: Set against the vibrant backdrop of Kolkata, this emotional drama weaves together the lives of dreamers searching for love, purpose, and belonging. As their journeys intersect through art, relationships, and personal struggles, they discover the strength to hold on to hope in a city filled with chaos, heartbreak, and possibility.

results.title: Relentless
results.overview: A homeless man targets a well-off elite in a home invasion. But it will take an unhinged level of brutality to find out his true motive.

results.title: Don't Let the Sun
results.overview: In a world almost like ours, Jonah works for an agency that offers human relationships. When he's hired to serve as Nika's father, he begins to lose control of his tightly controlled life.

results.title: Moondram Kan
results.overview: Follows the investigation of a factory general manager's murder, where four workers—a mechanic, assistant manager, owner, and new recruit—become the primary suspects.

results.title: Destroying Desmond
results.overview: When a successful author’s ex-girlfriends discover they’ve been cursed by his newfound success, they band together to destroy his reputation, only to realize they must confront their own bitterness and insecurities to break the curse and find true happiness.

results.title: Analogies
results.overview: A daring horror-anthology film built from seven segments, each by a different director, unified under the theme of taboo, the body and the repressed. The collection turns its gaze toward the most demonised and fetishised frontier of bodily representation — the anus — and uses this “hidden” territory to explore anxiety, identity, desire, repression and liberation. The stories vary in tone and style—some digital-age allegory, some dream-like psychological journeys, some extreme body-horror—but all form a choral fresco: each segment maintains its individual voice while entering into a dialogue with the others. The project positions itself not simply as provocation but as a political, aesthetic dissection of the obscene, asking where cinema’s boundaries lie, and what is suppressed, shown or revealed.

results.title: Jadau
results.overview: An emotional and complicated love story challenged by the traditional caste barriers in Nepali society.
